title: A year lost and a life affected
odia: ଚଷା ହୁଡ଼ିଲେ ବରଷେ, ମଣିଷ ହୁଡିଲେ ପୁରୁଷେ
literal_meaning: If the cultivator goes wrong, a year is lost; if a person goes wrong, a lifetime.
explanation: A seasonal mistake is contrasted with a decision that can shape a life. The warning concerns the scale of consequences, not the impossibility of recovery.
meaning_odia: ଚାଷର ଭୁଲରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ବର୍ଷର କ୍ଷତି ହୋଇପାରେ; ଜୀବନର ବଡ଼ ଭୁଲର ପ୍ରଭାବ ଦୀର୍ଘକାଳ ରହିପାରେ।
usage_example: Before making a lasting commitment, someone pauses to consider consequences beyond the present season. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The cited sense defines ପୁରୁଷ as lifetime, not generation. ଚଷା is read in the farming image; no caste-wide trait is asserted.
